notes_for_editor: One source only. The row's coordinates match the record (34.74800, -84.51531). The elevation 2063 has no unit on the page; the record's 628.8 m assumes feet. The row carries no note and no datasheet number, and the list gives no PID to look up. The name is a compiler label (the entry is number 84, above the 1-72 USGS range). The NHLR Georgia index and the Forest Lookouts Georgia index, as cached, do not list a New Hope in Gilmer County. The Forest Lookouts index lists an Amicalola Mountain tower in Gilmer County; it is a different entry and is not linked. Nothing about build, staffing, fires, status or access was found.
